//: Files that must stay byte-identical with the FieldAgent web app. See scripts/mirror.mjs and docs/architecture.md. Formatting is deliberately NOT applied to src/shared (see .prettierignore) - reformatting would break the mirror.

files.why: Due-date maths, due-level thresholds and dashboard assembly. If these drift, the two clients disagree about whether a fire check is overdue.

notYetMirrored.//: Shared in spirit, blocked on a small web-side refactor - see docs/architecture.md.
notYetMirrored.src/lib/cluster.ts: Pure, but type-imports LatLng from geocode.ts, which uses localStorage. Needs LatLng moved to its own module.
notYetMirrored.src/lib/geocode.ts: Caches in localStorage; needs the cache injected rather than assumed.
notYetMirrored.src/lib/types.ts: Contract types are identical, but the queue types carry Blob; mobile stores photo bytes as files on disk.
notYetMirrored.src/lib/sync.ts: buildSubmitBody is pure; the rest imports the web IndexedDB layer.
